# Issue and action (`issue` v1)

An audit, regulatory or self-identified issue, its owner, due date and actions.

**Group:** Operational and non-financial risk · **Mnemonic:** `ISSUE` · **Identifiers:** `ISSUE-…` in `issueId`

Open one with `ISSUE <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: issue
version: 1
description: "An audit, regulatory or self-identified issue, its owner, due date and actions."
match: { kind: issue, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Operational and non-financial risk · Issue and action, id: $.issueId }
strip:
  - { label: Title, bind: $.title }
  - { label: Source, bind: $.source }
  - { label: Severity, bind: $.severity, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Owner, bind: $.owner }
  - { label: Due, bind: $.due, fmt: date }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: actions
    kind: ladder
    title: Actions
    key: F2
    rows: $.actions
    columns:
      - { label: Due, bind: "@.due", fmt: date }
      - { label: Action, bind: "@.action" }
      - { label: Status, bind: "@.status", tone: status }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.desk, 'desk')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
